title: AssemblyAIProxy
description: supabase/functions/assemblyai-proxy/index.ts. A PATH-FORWARDING proxy, unlike the single-endpoint anthropic/openai proxies: the client calls <functionsBase>/assemblyai-proxy/v2/<anything> and the function strips the /assemblyai-proxy prefix and forwards the remainder (must start with /v2/) plus the original method/body/query string to https://api.assemblyai.com. Used for pre-recorded FILE transcription (/v2/upload, /v2/transcript, /v2/transcript/:id) — NOT the realtime streaming path, which uses mint-assemblyai-token instead. Billed by audio minutes, not tokens, so this meters one request rather than a token count. No fixed request/response body shape at the proxy level — every /v2/* AssemblyAI REST endpoint has its own contract (upload accepts raw audio bytes; POST /v2/transcript accepts {audio_url, ...options}; GET /v2/transcript/:id returns a transcript object with a status field). Out of scope to redefine AssemblyAI's own API surface here; only the proxy's own request-routing constraint and error shape are modeled below. (Deliberately no root `type`/`properties` here beyond $defs — quicktype's JSON Schema resolver chokes on a bare `type: object` root with no `properties`, even when a specific $def is targeted instead of the root.)

path.description: Present only alongside error=path_not_allowed; echoes the rejected subpath.
